CDISC Definition: Those units of time that are routinely used to express the age of a subject.
A unit of measurement of time equal to 24 hours.
A unit of measurement of time equal to 60 minutes.
One of the 12 divisions of a year as determined by a calendar. It corresponds to the unit of time of approximately to one cycle of the moon's phases, about 30 days or 4 weeks. (NCI)
Any period of seven consecutive days. (NCI)
The period of time that it takes for Earth to make a complete revolution around the sun, approximately 365 days; a specific one year period. (NCI)
Terminology relevant to the names given to a reference source that lists words and gives their meaning.

CDISC Synonym(s): CDISC Controlled Terminology; Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium Controlled Terminology
CDISC Definition: A standard terminology developed and maintained by Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) and the National Cancer Institute Enterprise Vocabulary Services (NCI-EVS) to support CDISC models, domains and specifications for data representation in regulated research.
NCI Preferred Term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium Controlled Terminology

CDISC Definition: An electronic registry and results database of clinical trial information submitted by sponsors, which informs users about ongoing clinical trials in the US.

CDISC Synonym(s): Coding Symbols for a Thesaurus of Adverse Reaction Terms
CDISC Definition: A terminology developed and used by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the coding, filing and retrieving of post marketing adverse reaction reports. (NCI)
NCI Preferred Term: Thesaurus of Adverse Reaction Term Coding Symbols

CDISC Synonym(s): Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events
CDISC Definition: A standard terminology developed and maintained by the National Cancer Institute to report adverse events occurring in cancer clinical trials. The CTCAE contains a grading scale for each adverse event term representing the severity of the event. (NCI)
NCI Preferred Term: Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events

CDISC Definition: An electronic registry database of clinical trial information submitted by sponsors, which informs users about ongoing clinical trials in European Union (EU) member states and European Economic Area (EEA) countries.

CDISC Synonym(s): Data Universal Number System; DUNS Numbers
CDISC Definition: A proprietary system developed and regulated by Dun & Bradstreet that assigns a unique nine digit numeric identifier to a single business entity location.

CDISC Synonym(s): European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials Database
CDISC Definition: The European Union's electronic database of clinical trials, which contains information submitted by sponsors and informs users about ongoing clinical trials in EU Member States and European Economic Area countries.
NCI Preferred Term: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials Database

CDISC Definition: The system for managing and analysing information on suspected adverse reactions to medicines which have been authorised or being studied in clinical trials in the European Economic Area (EEA). The European Medicines Agency (EMA) operates the system on behalf of the European Union (EU) medicines regulatory network. (EMA)
Codes for the representation of names of countries and their subdivisions that have been approved by the US Board on Geographic Names.

A system of categories to which morbid entries are assigned according to established criteria. Included is the entire range of conditions in a manageable number of categories, grouped to facilitate mortality reporting. It is produced by the World Health Organization (from ICD-10, p1). The Clinical Modifications, produced by the United States Dept. of Health and Human Services, are larger extensions used for morbidity and general epidemiological purposes, primarily in the U.S. (MSH2005_2004_10_12)

CDISC Synonym(s): International Classification of Diseases for Oncology
CDISC Definition: A World Health Organization (WHO) multi-axial classification of the site, morphology, behaviour, and grading of neoplasms.
NCI Preferred Term: International Classification of Diseases for Oncology

CDISC Definition: An international standard for harmonized data types for information interchange, developed and maintained by the International Organization for Standards (ISO).
An international standard for country and subdivision codes, developed and maintained by the International Organization for Standards (ISO).

CDISC Synonym(s): Japan Registry for Clinical Trials; Japan Registry of Clinical Trials
CDISC Definition: An electronic registry database of clinical trial information submitted by sponsors, which informs users about ongoing clinical trials in Japan.

CDISC Synonym(s): Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes
CDISC Definition: Published by The Regenstrief Institute, the Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes covers clinical and clinical laboratory terminology. (NCI)
NCI Preferred Term: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes

CDISC Definition: A standard terminology developed and maintained by the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) that includes terminology to support the mechanism of action, physiologic effect, and asserted pharmacologic classification relationships of medications. MED-RT incorporates terminology from RxNORM, MeSH, and SNOMED CT.
An international medical terminology designed to support the classification, retrieval, presentation, and communication of medical information, particularly to regulatory authorities.

The US National Library of Medicine's controlled vocabulary thesaurus used for indexing articles for PubMed. It consists of sets of terms and descriptions in a hierarchical structure that permits searching at various levels of specificity.
A web application from the US National Library of Medicine (NLM) that provides a single query interface for biomedical journal articles.

A structured nomenclature and classification of the terminology used in human and veterinary medicine developed by the College of Pathologists and American Veterinary Medical Association. (CDISC Glossary)

CDISC Synonym(s): SRS-UNII; Substance Registration System-Unique Ingredient Identifier
CDISC Definition: A standard terminology developed and maintained by the Department of Veterans Affairs/Veterans Health Administration designated federal collaborative Structured Product Labeling Interagency Expert Panel (SPLIEP). It contains terminology to support the mechanism of action, physiologic effect, and asserted pharmacologic classification relationships of drug ingredients and food allergens.

A World Health Organization (WHO) classification system, developed and maintained by the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology, for medicinal substances where active substances are divided into different groups according to the organ or system on which they act and their therapeutic, pharmacological, and chemical properties.

CDISC Synonym(s): World Health Organization Adverse Reaction Terms
CDISC Definition: A terminology implemented by the World Health Organization to describe adverse reactions to a prescribed medication or treatment regimen. (NCI)
NCI Preferred Term: World Health Organization Adverse Reaction Terminology

CDISC Synonym(s): UMC Drug Dictionary; UMCDD; Uppsala Monitoring Centre Drug Dictionary; WHODrug Global; World Health Organization Drug Dictionary
CDISC Definition: A reference source of drugs and drug associated information maintained by the World Health Organization. (NCI)
A term that is used to indicate a question with permissible values of yes/no/unknown/not applicable.
NCI Preferred Term: CDISC SDTM Yes No Unknown or Not Applicable Response Terminology

CDISC Definition: The non-affirmative response to a question. (NCI)
Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context. (NCI)
Not known, not observed, not recorded, or refused. (NCI)
The affirmative response to a question. (NCI)
A scale that defines the degree or state of disease existing in a patient as a result of the occurrence of an adverse event. (NCI)
NCI Preferred Term: CDISC SDTM Severity Intensity Scale for Adverse Event Terminology

CDISC Definition: A type of adverse event that is usually transient and may require only minimal treatment or therapeutic intervention. The event does not generally interfere with usual activities of daily living.

A type of adverse event that is usually alleviated with additional specific therapeutic intervention. The event interferes with usual activities of daily living, causing discomfort but poses no significant or permanent risk of harm to the research participant.
A type of adverse event that interrupts usual activities of daily living, or significantly affects clinical status, or may require intensive therapeutic intervention.

A terminology codelist relevant to the assemblage of physical properties or qualities by which male is distinguished from female; the physical difference between male and female; the distinguishing peculiarity of male or female.
NCI Preferred Term: CDISC SDTM Sex of Individual Terminology

CDISC Definition: A person who belongs to the sex that normally produces ova. The term is used to indicate biological sex distinctions, or cultural gender role distinctions, or both. [The NCI Thesaurus contains biomedical terminologies that NCI does not own or control. This concept contains gender-related content that does not comply with Executive Order 14168.]
A person (one of unisexual specimens) who is born with genitalia and/or secondary sexual characteristics of indeterminate sex, or which combine features of both sexes. (NCI)

A person who belongs to the sex that normally produces sperm. The term is used to indicate biological sex distinctions, cultural gender role distinctions, or both. [The NCI Thesaurus contains biomedical terminologies that NCI does not own or control. This concept contains gender-related content that does not comply with Executive Order 14168.]
Not known, not observed, not recorded, or refused. (NCI)
